# crusoe_kubernetes_addons (Data Source)

Available only to organizations enrolled by Crusoe support; the API rejects it otherwise. Reach out to support@crusoecloud.com to enable it.

Fetches the add-ons installed on a Crusoe Kubernetes cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crusoe_kubernetes_addons" "example" {
  cluster_id = "my-cluster-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the Kubernetes cluster the add-on belongs to.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the add-on belongs to. If not specified, the project ID will be inferred from the Crusoe configuration.

### Read-Only

- `addons` (Attributes List) List of add-ons. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addons))
- `id` (String) ID of the cluster the add-ons were listed for.

<a id="nestedatt--addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addons`

Read-Only:

- `addon_type` (String) Type of the add-on, e.g. `cert-manager`.
- `category` (String) Category of the add-on. Possible values: `preinstalled`, `optional`.
- `installed_version` (String) Version installed on the cluster. Empty until installation completes.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the add-on is ready.
- `status` (String) Current installation status of the add-on. Empty until installation starts.
- `version` (String) Version of the add-on. If omitted, the default version for the cluster's Kubernetes version is used.
